tex_content.html: \begin{equation} \partial _t(M_{ij}M^{ij})=2\lambda M_{ij}M^{ij}+(M_{ij}M^{ij})_{;k}^{\ \ k} -2M_{ij;k}M^{ij;k}+Q(\Rm ,M), \end{equation} where $Q$ is linear in $\Rm $ and quadratic in $M$. Choose $\lambda $ sufficiently negative and apply the maximum principle, using $M(0)=0$ and decay at spatial infinity, to obtain $M=0$. A Killing field satisfies $u^{m\, k}_{\ \ ;k}+R^m_{\ i}u^i=0$, so the evolved fields are time-independent and generate the rotational symmetry. □
